verdict.rationale: The firm's own pages publish a named startup program, Prarambh, with stated terms: a 10-week cohort, eligibility for registered businesses at least one year old, and a 12-stage programme offering mentorship and access to its lawyers. However, it is a legaltech incubator rather than a general founder legal-services package, and no fee terms are published. Missing for 10: any stated fee structure (deferred fees, fixed-fee formation pricing, or free or discounted legal work), availability to non-legaltech founders, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes a startup package — deferred fees, fixed-fee formation, or a named program with stated terms — on its own pages

citations.quote: Prarambh is India's first Legaltech incubator launched by cam in February 2019, with the aim of nurturing young entrepreneurs
The duration of the cohort will be 10 weeks which may be extended at the discretion of the firm
every startup that becomes part of the Prarambh ecosystem goes through a 12-stage programme that offers end-to-end solutions
the selected innovator companies will be provided mentorship, counselling and guidance by the Prarambh team
